Import Assets

Paste rows copied straight from Excel/Sheets (including the header row), or upload a CSV/XLSX/JSON file. Expected columns: Asset #, Category, Owner, Location, Assignment Date, Returned Date, Return Condtion, Notes (extra columns and different spellings are handled automatically). Multiple rows for the same asset tag are merged into one asset with its full assignment history.

Import PC List

Paste rows copied straight from Excel/Sheets (tab or comma separated) including the header row, or upload a CSV/XLSX file. Expected columns: Name, Type, Model#, Service tag#, Engineer, Division, Ship Date, Years old, Shipped From, Customs/Tax, Notes, Column1 (the storage size is picked up automatically whether it sits under Notes or Column1). Re-importing updates existing PCs by Name instead of duplicating them. The list is saved in this browser — it is not sent to any database.
